an6.102:1.1: [sāvatthinidānaṃ] cha bhikkhave ānisaṃse sampassamānena alameva bhikkhunā sabbasaṅkhāresu anodhiṃ karitvā aniccasaññaṃ upaṭṭhāpetuṃ.
an6.102:1.3: sabbasaṅkhārā ca me anavaṭṭhitato khāyissanti, sabbaloke ca me mano nābhiramissati, sabbalokā ca me mano vuṭṭhahissati, nibbānapoṇaṃ ca me mānasaṃ bhavissati, saṃyojanā ca me pahāṇaṃ gacchanti, paramena ca sāmaññena samannāgato bhavissatīti.
an6.102:1.4: ime kho bhikkhave cha ānisaṃse sampassamānena alameva bhikkhunā sabbasaṅkhāresu anodhiṃ karitvā aniccasaññaṃ upaṭṭhāpetunti.
